question: Why do mental constructions still seem to bear fruit in experience?
premises: Mental constructions and similar projections appear to bear fruit.
This happens mostly through constructions of mind and related faculties.
Underlying them is the sovereignty of freedom that manifests multiplicity.
inference: Mental constructions bear experiential fruit because consciousness freely manifests multiplicity through them.
plain_english: Even so, such things mostly bear fruit through constructions of the mind and the like, because of the sovereign freedom that manifests multiplicity.
